Sandbox_PhunInteriors_Debug_tooltip: Verbose logging for room leases, scrubs and containment
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_WeightFactor_toolt: Percentage of the interior contents weight added to the vehicle. Affects handling, acceleration and braking. Set to 0 to make interior loot weightless. Above 100 exaggerates the effect, which is mostly useful for feeling it at all: a van weighs around two tonnes, so realistic loot barely registers
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_ExitTax_tooltip: If yes, zombies near the vehicle build up while you are inside, so you come out to a bigger crowd than you left. Turn off to wait out the night for free
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_ExitTaxGrowth_tool: Extra zombies added per hour spent inside
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_EntryDelay_tooltip: Seconds it takes to get inside. Interruptible. Set to 0 to enter instantly
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_EntryAtBoardingPoi: If yes, you walk to the back of a van or the door of a caravan to get inside, rather than going in from anywhere beside it
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_EntryBlockedByZomb: If yes, you cannot get inside while a zombie is close, so the interior is not an escape hatch mid chase
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_EntryZombieRadius_: How close a zombie has to be to stop you getting inside
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_ExitShoveRadius_to: How many squares of ground are cleared around you when you come out. Coming out is a teleport, so you cannot see what you are landing in: anything standing inside this radius is shoved to the edge of it, as far as walls allow. The crowd is not removed and it is still coming. Set to 0 to land wherever you land
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_RoomProtectedDays_: Rooms are never taken away while any are free. Once every room is in use, a vehicle that needs one is given the room that has gone unused the longest, provided it has gone unused for at least this many days, and whatever was in it is cleared. Set to 0 to let any unused room be reused as soon as they are all taken. Set it to the maximum to never reuse a room at all: vehicles are simply refused once the last one is gone. A room somebody has claimed as a safehouse is never reused whatever this says
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_PowerBinding: Interior runs off the vehicle battery
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_PowerBinding_toolt: The room is lit by a generator fuelled from the vehicle battery. A flat battery means a dark room, and time spent inside costs charge. Turn off to leave interior power alone.
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_PowerDrainFactor_t: How much battery charge the room costs, as a percentage of what the generator burns. 100 is one full battery per full tank. 0 means the lights are free.
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_ScrubKeepsLoot_too: If yes, loot in a reclaimed room is salvaged rather than destroyed when the room is reset
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_HardenShell_toolti: If yes, the outer shell of a room cannot be destroyed or burned. A room can override this either way in the room editor. Containment does not depend on this
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_BreachEjects_toolt: If yes, leaving the room any way other than the door puts you back at the vehicle. If no, you are simply moved back inside
Sandbox_PhunInteriors_AdminNoClipExempt_: If yes, an admin with noclip turned on is ignored by room containment, so they can inspect and pass through rooms without being ejected. Turning noclip off puts them back under the normal rules
